subject: Label Propagation
source_sentence: We used the Junto label prop- agation toolkit for label propagation.
title: Graph Propagation for Paraphrasing Out-of-Vocabulary Words in Statistical Machine Translation∗

subject: Word Alignment
source_sentence: Word alignment is done using GIZA++.
title: Graph Propagation for Paraphrasing Out-of-Vocabulary Words in Statistical Machine Translation∗

subject: Language Model
source_sentence: For the language model, we used the KenLM toolkit to create a 5-gram language model on the target side of the Europarl corpus (v7) with approximately 54M tokens with Kneser-Ney smoothing.
title: Graph Propagation for Paraphrasing Out-of-Vocabulary Words in Statistical Machine Translation∗

subject: log-linear
source_sentence: The probability for new entries are added as a new feature in the log-linear framework to be tuned along with other features.
title: Graph Propagation for Paraphrasing Out-of-Vocabulary Words in Statistical Machine Translation∗

subject: Word Alignments
source_sentence: The resulting word alignments are used to extract the translations for each oov.
title: Graph Propagation for Paraphrasing Out-of-Vocabulary Words in Statistical Machine Translation∗

subject: Evaluation metrics
source_sentence: Two intrinsic evaluation metrics that we use to evaluate the possible translations for oovs are Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) and Recall.
title: Graph Propagation for Paraphrasing Out-of-Vocabulary Words in Statistical Machine Translation∗

subject: Moses
source_sentence: Since Moses uses a certain number of translations per source phrase (called the translation table limit or ttl which we set to 20 in our experiments), we use the recall measure to evaluate the top ttl translations in the list.
title: Graph Propagation for Paraphrasing Out-of-Vocabulary Words in Statistical Machine Translation∗
